title: Sikkim & Darjeeling
tagline: Monasteries, tea gardens and Kanchenjunga sunrises
description: Two of the Eastern Himalaya's most loved hill towns sit within a day's drive of each other. Gangtok, Sikkim's capital, is a calm, colourful city of monasteries and prayer flags, and the gateway to the glacial Tsomgo Lake and the shrine of Baba Mandir high on the road to Nathula.

Darjeeling unfolds across tea-covered ridges, with the toy train puffing through town and Kanchenjunga — the world's third-highest mountain — glowing pink and gold at sunrise from Tiger Hill. Add Mirik, Namchi and a cup of first-flush tea, and the mountains do the rest.

highlights.title: Tiger Hill sunrise
highlights.text: Watch first light sweep across Kanchenjunga and, on clear days, catch a glimpse of Everest.

highlights.title: Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir
highlights.text: A sacred glacial lake at 3,750 m ringed by snowy peaks, with yak rides along its shore.

highlights.title: Monasteries & viewpoints
highlights.text: Enchey and Ghoom monasteries, Do Drul Chorten, Ganesh Tok and the Batasia Loop.

highlights.title: Darjeeling tea & toy train
highlights.text: Walk the estates that grow the 'champagne of teas' and ride the UNESCO-listed Himalayan Railway.
